# HexPiece 3.4.1

Dawn Pistol, after your notes on 3.4.0 ("does the arm bend? I dont want it to be a straight line", "Excuse me??? How IS THIS IN HELL
STRAIGHT" with the arm traced on your Egghead frame, and "It also has to be FAST, but when it lands and stuns (the skin streches to the
limit slower and slower (the further it gets) and when it reaches the max, the entity is projected in a straight line FAST. adding a dust
explosion on landing (and making a crater)"). Not tested in game yet: the build and all tests pass, and the move was rendered and judged
(docs/gifs/nika-dawn-pistol-3.4.1.gif is a preview, not the game: the stretched skin is painted red there, the body's own skin in game).

- **The arm is never straight.** It whips back from your shoulder, swings round in a big loop and comes into the body fast (out in a fifth
  of a second), the whole way a smooth rubber curve, Haki-black, the fist following the curve.
- **The fist goes on through the body.** When it lands, the body is stunned in place and the arm keeps going straight through it, the
  body's own skin stretched out round the fist, fast at first and slower and slower the further it gets, to about 7 blocks, glowing
  white-hot round the fist (half a second in all).
- **At the limit the body is shot away in a straight line, fast** (5 blocks a tick, no falling for its first 8 ticks), tearing through
  every block up to obsidian (they grow back by themselves after 15 to 25 seconds), then drops.
- **Where it lands: a crater and a dust explosion** (dust, rings pressed into the ground, rocks, cracks; the crater fills back in by
  itself), the ground shaking, a boom, and with the Conqueror's Haki and Ryou on, the Conqueror's lightning out of it.
